This game allows to choose between various number of game modes with the primary target to beat all rivals. Other available options include multiplayer, motorcycle characteristics, circuit or meteorology.

And then, in the World Championship you can choose another option: see the stats of your competitors (his times in the trainings, records and position in start line), also you can run the official training on each circuit to be placed on the best position to start the race.

The game includes 16 circuits in total (the official of this competition), you can try it by separate to train, but if you want to win the title you must to show your abilities in each one of them since the first. Another feature of Pole 500 is the possibility to run in training mode or Championship mode with 2 players simultaneously (in this case the screen will be sectioned horizontally).

124628.overview:
Answer Back: Junior Quiz is an Educational game, developed and published by Kosmos, which was released in 1990. Game provides a unique adventure in education by allowing the successful challenger to participate in a simple and compelling game. The software package contains a highly sophisticated control program and fifteen thought-provoking quizzes, each covering a different topic in general knowledge.

Game of questions and answers with numerous options, in which a game of "Dragons and Princesses" is combined with questions oriented to children of 6 and 12 years.

124629.overview:
Antago is a puzzle game played on a 5x5 square board. It can be played either against the computer, with a choice of up to 10 levels of difficulty, or against another human player. Other options allow you to play a match or start a training session, as well as select between "plain" (empty board) and "prepared" (pre-arranged balls on the board) game modes. A demo mode is also available, where the computer plays against itself.

An angel and a devil compete against each other, with the goal of aligning five "balls" in a row on the board, either horizontally, vertically or diagonally. They are moved around the board with the joystick, pushing each other as their paths cross, and strategically placing balls on the edge of the board to both disrupt their opponent's lines and try to create a line of 5 of their own balls.

Each level features different background and board graphics. There is no background music playing during the game, and only basic sound effects when the two characters push each other, place a ball on the board and win.

124630.overview:
Antares is a classic role-playing game of the Bard's Tale variety set in a science-fiction scenario. After the radio contact with space explorers stopped, a second troop goes to look for them. Unfortunately on the way they receive a emergency call, get shot and have to land on the planet Kyrion. Now the troop has to explore the planet and find out more about what happened.

The party has six members (chosen from twelve pre-defined characters) with different statistics and abilities, e.g. fighting, cooking, PSI (the science-fiction variant of magic) or translating (needed to communicate with non-hostile species). The world and dungeons are explored through a first-person perspective and when meeting enemies, the fight plays out turn-based: the player tells the characters what to do and text informs of the results. Killing enemies reward experience points which in turn improve the abilities.

Each character has to eat and sleep. While too much hunger results in death, a sleeping character is in a kind of trance: he still walks around, but can't take any actions or fight. Besides sleeping, there is also medicine available to keep the spirits up: just like other parts of equipment, it can be bought in hidden shops with gold found at slain enemies. Each character can transport up to six items and a radar shows how dangerous the current area is. Dead party members can be resurrected at the landing module.

124631.overview: Apache Flight is a vertically scrolling shooter in which the player spends the most time shooting enemies by using the two available weapons: the unlimited standard ammo (released by tapping the fire button) and limited missiles (released by holding the fire button) which are required to hit ground targets, e.g. cannons and tanks. Those missiles are also available in the heat-seeking variety which are automatically used up first. Fuel is limited and is constantly drained every second, but it can be refilled by hovering over fuel depots which are regularly encountered during the levels. However, when shooting them with a missile instead, the depot releases additional missiles to collect. Of course it is also important to dodge enemies and their bullets because every hit causes the loss of a life. When that happens, a new helicopter with reset fuel and missiles appears with a brief invincibility period at the point of death. The game is lost when all lives are gone.

124632.overview:
A succession of terrorists must be wiped out to keep the planet safe. That job falls to Arnie, a big musclebound hero of Germanic origin.

The game's levels each scroll horizontally, as opposed to the isometric view used in the sequel. They see you trying to find positions to attack the minions, before finally reaching the end of level targets.

124633.overview:
Arnie 2 is an isometric action game. Although it's obvious to which Hollywood actor the game's name alludes, Arnie 2 is not a licensed title and not based on any movie.

It is the sequel to the Amiga / C64 platform game Arnie (1992). Unlike the previous title it has been developed in-house by Zeppelin

Fast reflexes and a lust for violence are required for success here. Your average muscleman shoots and bombs his way through four enemy-infested territories: Shut down a chemical plant by blowing up enough pipeline valves. Clear an airfield from enemy soldiers, tanks and helicopters. Climb from battleship to battleship in a hostile harbor. And finally, rescue as many prisoners as possible from a jungle POW camp.

Naturally, the levels are crawling with enemies: from simple infantry armed with rifles, mortars or rocket launchers to MG teams, missile batteries and tanks. Most of the opponents are stationary and stolidly fire in a single direction; however, foxholes spew out cannon-fodder at a constant rate. To destroy such nests or efficiently dispatch groups of soldiers, Arnie has a (limited) supply of grenades. Some deceased foes drop more powerful weapons as well as invaluable first aid kits and extra lives.

124634.overview:
The Amiga version of the game was ported by the French developer Microïds. They only released the game in French (L'Art de la Guerre) and Spain (El Arte de la Guerra).

L'Art de la Guerre is a real-time strategy game based on the very basic elements of war: unit types, formation, and strength. The game is set in ancient battle-style times before the use of gun powder, consisting of the three basic unit types of that period: the light armored but fast 'barbarians', the heavily armored but slow 'knights', and the ranged 'archers'. A fourth non-combatant unit type is also available: 'spies', which is only available under certain campaign rule settings. 

The game consists of different scenarios to choose from, each with a different geographical setting, difficulty setting, visibility setting, and victory condition setting. Some settings may be subject to change by the player.

Gameplay is represented in two major areas:
The first is the tactical/political map, which visualizes geographical and terrain elements from a top-down perspective. Here the player can coordinate, position, reinforce troops, and also command them to attack, defend or ambush enemy troops in a real-time setting. Time may be set to pause, faster or slower to make battle plans easier.

The second is the combat screen where one group of soldiers fight another group of the enemy. A squad consisting a maximum of 14 soldiers will fight according to their set battle formation and will act only on the player's real-time battle commands (e.g. attack, forward, retreat, etc.).
The difficulty levels are represented by eight opponents, which include the Greek goddess of war Athena, a stereotypical Russian-Soviet commander named Crazy Ivan, as well as the historical characters Alexander the Great, Julius Caesar, Genghis Khan, Napoleon, Geronimo, and Sun Tzu as the hardest opponent. Each opponent has a different fighting style of combat and strategy.

The game also comes with a construction set which allows the player to create own campaigns: From the story, rules to the map editor. In this game editor, the player can also tweak troops to the player's liking, such as default troop formations.

124635.overview:
This chess simulation can be played in 2D or 3D, from multiple viewing angles and a wide choice of display colors. Pieces can also be designed using Deluxe Paint, and imported. 

Art of Chess has many features making it a learning tool as well as a mere game. There are multiple skill levels, plus the option to swap sides. Board positions can be manually set up. Players can move back and forth through previous moves, allowing experimentation with different strategies and the undoing of crucial mistakes. Thirty classic games involving Grandmasters are built in, allowing players to view them move-by-move, or take part themselves from any point.

124636.overview:
"The Go player must contend less with his opponent and more with conflicting
impulses and emotions within himself."
Go is based on the ancient board game of Chinese origin, which is very
popular today in Japan and other Asian countries.  In recent years, though,
the game has become increasingly popular in the United States, Canada, and
Europe because of its challenging nature.  The game is played with black and
white stones on a grid of 19 vertical and 19 horizontal lines. 

Although the rules of the game are very simple, the strategy necessary to
win is very complex -- comparable to chess.  The game will stimulate both
analytical and intuitive thought processes.

124637.overview:
This slow-paced methodical shoot 'em up is viewed from top down, with your ship flying up the screen. The game's levels have a clearly square design to them, with lots of barriers to negotiate as well as aliens (which generally stay in the same vertical plane as they fly towards you).

Many squares featuring a variety of power-up type effects, such as improved weaponry, extra lives, a level warp, a device to stop the landscape's (otherwise constant) scrolling (thereby giving you a chance to 'pick off' the aliens more carefully), and one which speeds up the aliens (avoid this!). You can move backwards a short way, but it takes a few squares' worth of screen to get fully across the screen, so bear this in mind in the mazier sections.

124638.overview:
Artura is a side-scrolling platform game. The game semi-utilizes the mythology of King Arthur in that you play as Artura, son of the Pendragon. Your goal is rescue Nimue, apprentice to Merdyn, from your evil half-sister Morgause. 

You will battle numerous horrible creatures such as spiders and bats with your axe and avoid deadly traps while attempting to gain access to Morgause's castle. You will also search for 6 runes, which contain spells, that you must find in order to free Nimue. Artura contains 4 maze-like levels that are so complicated that poster sized map of the levels is included with the game.

124639.overview: Another representative of numerous group called 'space shooters'. With classic cosmic ship under your command you have two usual objectives to fulfill - destroy everything and try to survive. There are 4 similar levels further split into two parts. Second part is always harder because the end of it is occupied by huge/powerful boss. You start the mission with a few lives in stock and two problems: the ship is too slow and equipped with basic single fire only. Try to shoot to bits special transport so you'll be awarded with "Speed Up" (to accelerate movement of your ship) or "Power Up" (to increase power of one and only weapon in this game). Other collectible items are "500", "1000", "5000" points and finally "1 Up" (one life). There is no time to rest during the mission because you're constantly threatened by hundreds of enemies and different obstacles. Get ready for flying types like bombs, orbs, various ships and ground types like shooting turret, laser gates and many more.

124641.overview:
Welcome to Astatin, the game of the nobility of Radon, it was brought to Earth for you by Alive Designs. A New Challenge If you thought it wasn't possible to continue wrecking your nerves, then you should pick up this game. For 100 levels you can solve the tasks given to you with drops of sweat on your forehead. You might be one of the lucky ones to survive this game unscathed. 
 
Astatin is a Puzzle game, developed by Alive Designs and published by Talesoft, which was released in Europe in 1992. The game is to make the pictures on the area on the left match the ones given on the right. However, the pictures will change corresponding to changes\pictures around them, so the one you choose may influence the ones around them. Find the pattern and pass the level.

124642.overview:
The game is based on famous comics, animations and movies series about brave independent Gauls, who drink magic power potions and fight with Romans.

This time Asterix and Obelix fly on the magic carpet to India with Cacofonix, whose song can make the rain for the friendly Indian villagers. But during the travel he lost his voice. Now Asterix and Obelix have to find the cure for Cacofonix' voice and rescue Princess Orinjade, who will be sacrificed by evil Hoodunnit if it isn't raining.

During the game you watch the static cartoon scenes and choose the answers to progress in your travel. Sometimes you need an action, so it is action sequences in the game, for example, to defend the village from the robbers, etc.

124643.overview: Atax is an Action game, developed by Ramware and published by Eclipse Software, which was released in Europe in 1988.

124644.overview: Atomania is a Atomix variant. In each one-screen level, there are a number of atoms with different colors which need to be arranged in a certain fashion: a picture of the end result is displayed in the upper left corner. The player controls a cursor which has be moved over the atoms in order to send them on their way. However, they only stop when they hit a wall or another obstacle. The goal needs to be reached within a certain amount of moves and there are three difficulty levels.

124649.overview: Germany, November 9th 1989: The Berlin Wall has fallen. Now it is up to the player to organize and manage the "Aufschwung Ost" (German for "Upturn East" in reference to Eastern Germany, the former GDR) in this political business sim. Gameplay takes place on two scales: A large scale (East Germany) for power plants, highways and other infrastructure and a smaller, SimCity-like city-scale for specific buildings. Besides the historic "East Germany - 1989" scenario there six more, each with different problems (high pollution, national debt,...). None of them has a "goal" though so the game goes on forever (unless you decide to resign or you're kicked out of office due to bad work).

124650.overview:
Aunt Arctic Adventure is a platform game in which the player must guide Charlie the chimp through the levels to rescue his Aunt, who has been kidnapped and taken to the Arctic to work as a circus performer.

The game supports one or two players with the second player controlling Penguin Pete. Avoid baddies such as eskimos, spiders and penguins, whilst picking up items such as bananas to score extra points.

124651.overview:
Aussie Joker Poker is a point scoring card game for 2-90 players.

Each player is dealt a hand of five cards, and the hand is scored according to poker hand value, card value, and the suits involved.

After being dealt a hand, the player is displayed a score. The player can risk discarding cards to acquire a better hand, but if the point value is lessened, the player busts, and they forfeit points for that hand. The player can keep risking drawing new cards to improve their hand until they bust or are satisfied with their score.

Card are selecting using the numbers one to five, and they are graphically displayed on the screen. There is an option to display who the current leading hand is each round, and the score to beat. The player can define the number of rounds per game.

124652.overview:
Australo Piticus Mechanicus is a platform game exclusively published on the Amiga. The player has to guide the protagonist named Androids van Laptop on his journey to rescue his lost maiden.

The game itself flips screens, no scrolling is involved. In melee combat you can hit with your sword (if you have one), or throw stones if you want to stay at distance. Weapons can be purchased at shops, which are placed frequently on the platforms. During your way, you collect money and gems to stock up for better weapons. You can jump, take objects (especially keys), use objects, and often ladders have to be climbed. The game character has two attributes: hit points, representing the health, and strength, which defines how much damage the player's character is doing to enemies and is defined by the equipment and weapon the character is carrying.

There are eight levels. Beside the platform game, there is a futuristic gag: directly after loading the game you can decide not to enter the game, but the "system". The system is a text-based Unix-like console, in which by typing commands a Space Invaders game and some pictures of the developers can be found.

124653.overview:
Autoduel is a hybrid game based on Steve Jackson Games board game Car Wars. It incorporates elements of role-playing, driving and action-based combat. The game is set in a futuristic version of USA, where gangs and vigilantes rule the wilderness, and people's only protection are armored cars with mounted weaponry. The player is cast in the role of an average person who must at first earn enough money to buy an own car, and then perform courier missions throughout the country.

The game's progression is fairly open-ended: the player is free to visit different cities, explore highways, participate in car Arena battles to earn money, take on gangsters in the wilderness, salvage car parts, etc. A few courier missions must be completed in order to advance the story. The player can construct and customize vehicles using guns, mine-layers, smokescreens, oil slicks, rockets and other accessories, choosing between various body and chassis types for the car. The entire game is viewed from a top-down perspective.

124654.overview:
This game puts you behind the controls of the AV8B Harrier aircraft. You must plan a strategic assault upon the enemy island of East Timor which is heavily defended. As well as allowing you to fly the Harrier, you can also plan attacks with your ground and naval forces.

If you prefer the strategic side of things you can let the games AI fly the missions for you, whilst you concentrate on commanding the resources available to you to strike on the enemy.

124656.overview:
Pete Cooke's follow-up to the previous space shooter-explorer takes things away from the Tau Ceti setting. Players take the role of a student at an academy for advanced piloting. There they need to solve 20 simulated missions on a wide range of planets.

The self-contained missions mean that the game uses the Tau Ceti structure and theme, without the causality of previous decisions having an effect on later choices. This reduces the complexity of management. Although players can customize the ships, including giving them names of your choice, the game comes with supplied ones include a variety that should suit many different circumstances.

Whichever vehicle is chosen, players will control it from a 1st person perspective and a series of controls. All ships skim over the surface of the planet and feature weapons. Most missions will involve destroying rogue robots enemies. Players will have to dock with buildings to refuel or move on to a different planet.

124658.overview: Aztex is a platform shooter, developed and published by ECP, which was released in Australia in 1988. You shoot spears at a number of baddies, different ones can be defeated in different ways.

131530.overview:
Alien³ is a video game based on the movie of the same name. The plot of the movie picks up directly after the end of Aliens. Ellen Ripley, the main character of the Alien series, is in cryo-sleep aboard the space ship Sulaco. Unfortunately, an alien or two has stowed away on the Sulaco, and wreaked havoc within the ship. Thus, it crash lands on the prison colony planet Fiorina 161. Ripley and the unarmed prisoners have to figure out a way to survive the aliens terrorizing the colony until help arrives.

The gameplay of the various Alien³ conversions varies from platform to platform. This version is a side-scrolling action game with large maze-like levels. In each level, you have to rescue all the trapped prisoners and then make your way to the exit, all while surviving multiple alien attacks.

131534.overview: Alert is an Amiga h-scrolling shoot'em up game somewhat resembling Silkworm released in 1988 by ECP.

135026.overview: The A-Train Construction Set add-on for Maxis’ railroad management simulation A-Train is a map editor that allows modification of existing savegames and creation of new landscapes from scratch. The editor comes with six sample scenarios. Apart from that, it adds no new content to the game.

140037.overview:
Air Bucks is a business simulation game which tries to capture the ins and outs of the airline industry without bogging the player down with details. It starts in 1946 and the goal is to build up a successful airline with a small starting budget. There are many details in the game, e.g. the player can buy rights to airports, arrange seats on the planes to carry more or less first class passengers, decide on the quality of in-flight food or entertainment, and more.

The game features "special events" similar to Sid Meier's Railroad Tycoon, which require quick changes in the plane operations to accommodate them. Other important industry-specific activities include designing global routes and paying for landing rights, tinkering with plane layouts and determining fares for each leg. All those decisions are made inside various menu screens. Competition consists of up to three human or AI controlled opponents and the world map is randomly generated with every new game.

140710.overview:
A motorcycle racing game recreating the now-defunct 80cc world motorcycle racing championship. It was licensed around Spanish ace Jorge Martinez 'Aspar', and your (and his) racing rivals including future 500cc World Champion Alex Criville.

The game features a full practice mode as well as qualifying and races. There are only 8 computer bikes, although the real life championship points system is used, meaning that the penalty for not finishing is bigger than in real life, especially as you only have 5 bikes to last the season. The game is viewed from overhead, and the controls are, unusually, direction based, so to take a straight which (in the overhead view) involves going up and to the right, you must push the joystick in that direction.

141095.overview: Eye of the Dragon is a nice little Mahjong game. The game offers a no-frills, no-nonsense Mahjong experience. If you don't know how to play the game, this one isn't for you as it doesn't provide any rules or guidance to introduce you to the game. If you already know how to play, though, the game provides a decent enough challenge for a quick Mahjong fix. If you are a Mahjong fan, there's probably nothing better than being able to quickly jump into a game, during that precious 10-15 minutes coffee break.

141733.overview:
A320 Airbus Vol. 2 is the second main game in the Airbus series following the first two that were split up based on the territory to cover. This flight simulator improves the original game by more authentic navigation systems, improved flight and control. Also, some improvements in usability in preparing a flight are included. Four new areas are added in Europe: Italy, Spain, Portugal and the Canaries. These four areas add 29 new airports and 200 new radio beacons.

The game includes a duty mode starting as a rookie to become a chief pilot. Evaluation is based on various factors such as the runaway landing angle or the conservation of reserve fuel. In the training mode the weather parameters can be set manually, but in duty mode they are selected randomly and need to be taken into account when setting the flight path. Players also need to tap in the coordinates to set up the navigational system.

The package includes a pilot's manual and approach charts.

141734.overview: If you want to fly a modern passenger jet then this is the sort of game for you. This is a serious simulation of flying which was developed in corporation with Lufthansa and Deutsche Airbus. The flying area includes most of Western Europe with about 80 airports. During gameplay you have to fly a specified route and navigate yourself by using the supplied map. There is also a training mode available.

141735.overview: A320 Airbus: Edition USA is the successor to A320 Airbus which focuses on a realistic simulation of flying. The main difference is a new flying area which covers the USA between the Western and Northeastern coasts with about 240 airports. Additionally the flight physics are improved. During gameplay the player has to fly specified routes and navigate himself by using the supplied map. There is also a training mode available.

142645.overview: Andromeda is a science fiction arcade game. The action takes place in the Year 2317 inside a space base localized in a Andromeda star system, near a star which will soon explode. Controlling the robot MSQ-2 the player must find all parts of the supercomputer. Unfortunately the defence system ceased to function properly and the player will have to avoid the hostile units and defence stations. Switching off the defense system requires finding four magnetic cards with secret codes. The game features around 150 locations divided into a few levels connected with elevator system. Some of the doors require collecting proper access cards, force fields and traps may switch off. Contact with hostile units and defence traps takes some energy. The energy level may be purchased in the computer for the money scattered around the base.

142940.overview:
Atron 5000 is a light cycle game for two players or one player against an AI driver. The game is played in split screen where player one has the top part of the screen while the AI or player two has the bottom part. Like in other games of its kind the player races a bike that leaves a trail behind and the objective is to stay alive longer than the opponent by not crashing into any walls, obstacles or the trails of either bike. The game consists of twelve levels and a single match goes through all of them. Each level is played twice except for the last one which is played three times.

Some power ups can be picked up and then activated. They are either red or yellow and the colours correspond with the colours of the bikes and when activated only the bike with the right colour is affected. There are four different ones: bombs that erase the bike's trail, S's that speed up the bike, M's that can blow a hole in a trail and W's that construct a wall in front of the opponent.

143430.overview:
Based on the graphic novel of the same name, this computer game Quest for the Time-Bird is a marvellous saga whose principal ingredients are action, danger, suspense, fantasy and magic.

You have nine days to complete your quest by exploring this vast unknown world of wizards and spells with Roxanna, daughter of Mara the witch and Bragon, a retired knight who once again goes back into life of danger, all for the great Quest of the Time-Bird!

143889.overview: Cricket is an Amiga cricket sports game released in 1990 by Soundware International.

146234.overview:
You take on the role of Dastardly and Mutley from the Hanna-Barbera cartoon series in this action title with superficial racing overtones. Your aim is to complete each course in a particular position, which is achieved either by waiting for them to suffer enough damage to drop out of the race, or by inflicting that damage yourself. Your car is armed with a forward-shooting arrow to impale the opposition cars, and deal with the many hazards the races throw at you, including boulders and rabbits, which can be taken out for points.

The action is viewed from the side, scrolling horizontally as you progress, and vertically when you need to jump or duck over the bigger hazards, which must be avoided Moon Patrol style, meaning that you must often time one jump properly so as to be able to make the next one successfully. In some sections of the road you can duck down onto another set of roads, which may or may not be less hazardous. Falling into thin air costs you a life, while heavy impacts deduct some of your energy points. When the view doesn’t show the next section, and the correct course is not clear, an arrow appears to direct you.

151878.overview: This simple Space Invaders clone was an unsuccessful entry in Amiga Power's 'Win A Job At Bullfrog!' competition.

153188.overview:
GunBee F-99 was an unlicensed port of Detana!! TwinBee for the Amiga, published by APC&TCP and developed by Twin Eagles Group.

There are two modes: Honey Mode, which served as a training mode, and Story Mode, which directed to the intro of the story. While the gameplay was based on TwinBee, the intro was similar to the one seen in Turrican 3: Payment Day. Kiara McGuire was a reference to Ben McGuire from the Turrican series.

175141.overview: Designed as a tool to assist dungeon masters in the tabletop role-playing game, Advanced Dungeons & Dragons, this computer program features a database of over 1,000 distinct encounters and more than 1,300 monsters.

176517.overview:
Atlantic HQ have lost contact with their top secret underwater base, Aquasphere 1. The last transmissions from the base were unclear but it is being officially reported to personal that unknown terrorist forces have invaded the complex.. As pilot of `THE SHARK`, the latest hi tech armed submersible, you have been brought in to investigate. 

Setting off for Aquasphere, you have your own suspicions about what has happened at the base.. During its construction, a huge area of the sea bed was destroyed, including the area known as "The quadrant", a weird and totally unnatural rock formation several hundred meters wide. Rumour has it that several attempts were made to map and investigate the area, each met with disappearance of the crew and vessel involved..

178323.overview: Adventures in Math is an educational game that teaches basic math concepts and covers kindergarten, first and second grade levels. Grade level can be chosen before starting a game and affects what activities the player will come across. The game takes place in a jungle that the player gets to explore by choosing different trails to follow. The aim is to earn points by finding animals and completing math challenges. When starting out the player gets a target score which has to be reached within a certain number of turns. Failing with math challenges leads to points being lost. Points can also be lost by being bitten by spiders which the player has to avoid by jumping over them.

178324.overview:
All About America is an educational game that teaches children American history and geography as well as the English language. It consists of two main activities: history lessons and map reading skills. Both of these can be played by one or two players.

History lessons include 16 different stories about America's past. These can be played in any order and consists of two parts: one where the player gets to read and watch pictures of the subject and one quiz part based on the story. There are two question types: reading skills that tests what the player remembers from the story and vocabulary building that tests how well the player knows some of the words that appeared in the story. For both question types the player has three alternatives to choose from.

When testing map reading skills there are three map types to choose from: the thirteen colonies, America before the civil war and the present United States. Like in the history activity the player can choose to look and learn or to do a quiz. For each map type there are different types of questions. For colonies there are only questions about the name of the colonies while for the civil war map there are both state names and postal codes and for present day USA there are also quizzes for capitals and compass directions.

181169.overview:
Addictaball is a Breakout clone with a twist. Players control a paddle to break down a wall of different block by bouncing a ball against them, but instead of removing them to clear a level, players need to make a path for the paddle to pass through. As time goes on, the bricks move lower down the screen so the path needs to be created as long as there is an opportunity. The game is over when the bricks hit the paddle.

There are different kinds of power-ups, weapons, a thruster to move over the screen, and a barrier at the bottom of the screen that prevents the ball from disappearing, but it degrades over time. There are also some vehicles at the bottom of the screen that can be hit. Cooperative games for two players are supported.

181170.overview: Alchemy is an unreleased game that only has a few demo levels. Apparently it was supposed to be published by Psygnosis, why that didn't happen nobody knows. The graphics and the sound make a very good impression, maybe Psygnosis could have created another cult platformer with it. Despite the colorful graphics, the game is satisfied with the OCS/ECS chipset.

181171.overview: The Wonders of The Animal Kingdom is an educational game for ages six to twelve that consists of six learning activities. The game intends to train a number of skills including reading comprehension, science knowledge, spelling, memory, logic and pattern recognition.

181434.overview:
After an attack by the forces of the Xenox Empire on the Princess Izra's fortress, the last handful of defenders have surrendered and you have taken charge. They looted the princess palace hoping to capture her but Robbo, Princess Izra's protective robot is there, with his powerful weapons he destroy's some enemies, giving the princess valuable time to escape in her super fast Starfighter but he eventually gets captured.

Robbo is imprisoned on a remote Xenox System and deprived of his weapons and ammunition. Robbo breaks out of prison but he finds the base abandoned. There are only a few broken escape pods left and Robbo has to collect all the screws from the entire base in order to fix the escape pods and return home.

Can he escape, It's up to you.

181475.overview: Apple Hunt is a Boulderdash clone with you picking up apples and avoiding getting squashed by large rocks.

181606.overview: World Golf is a Sports game, developed and published by Apex Systems, which was released in 1996. An addictive and truly original golf game for 1 to 4 players in practice and tournament modes. Five authentic courses from around the world. Five Skill levels. Select between 1, 2, 4 or 18 hole rounds. Auto and manual club selection. Ambient sound effects, realistic ball actions and far more!

190264.overview: Grand Master Design was a  pseudonym for  Scott Hayne which he used to develop two platformers for Amiga; Sound The Space Cadet and its sequel, Ace the Space-Case that he sold directly as a shareware.

195516.overview:
Artillerus 2 is a multi-player hot-seat artillery game.

On a random generated landscape of hills and valleys up to eight players can fight it out as you bomb each other into submission in this turn-based robot artillery battle.

At the start of each round, each player purchases their weaponry, and shields for defense. Then it's off to battle! Aim your cannon, paying attention to trajectory and wind. Shots are fired by selecting an angle and a velocity; the terrain is destructible, so craters can chip away at the landscape, or cause a player's robot to drop into the resulting pit causing extra damage.

The game offers a large variety of weapons and defenses. A small sample of these include shells, mortars, and bombs, nukes in various sizes, and special weapons that dig into the ground or explode multiple times. Or, if missiles aren't your thing, you can send your foes a personal gift of flaming napalm. There are also dirt bombs which can be used to bury yourself, for safety from opposing attacks.

200538.overview: Basic shooter - aim your ship with a mouse and shoot given number of aliens within a time limit. Nice soundtrack, at least.

201380.overview:
Amiga Mega Pak is a compilation that includes a mixture of games and utilities (some of which are PD):

DISK 1
• Inertia Drive
• Amiga Type
• Directory Utility II v. 4.0
• Cat & Mouse
• Rebound

DISK 2
• Diablo
• Shooting Star
• Jigsaw (Pieces)
• Pac Boy
• Reversi (A Reversi Player v. 6.1)
• YachtC
• Gridfire

205464.overview:
Versions for MS-DOS and Amiga were both produced in 1994, however the episodic publication of the Amiga version was cancelled in the wake of Commodore's demise. In 2007, coder Fabrizio Farenga made the entire series freely downloadable on his homepage, effectively marking the first Amiga release of the game.

The game follows the story of a young boy named Richard, who is magically transported to a fantasy world. There, a man named Golan recognizes him as the Chosen One who is set to restore balance in the world. Richard's task is to retrieve six lost gems, each held by a guardian at the service of the Evil One, and take them all to the Tree of Life.

La Storia Ancestrale is a point-and-click adventure game on fixed screens from a two-dimensional side view. Left-clicking on an object or exit causes Richard to walk there, right-clicking will have him look at the object, whereas left-clicking while holding the right button will perform a default action such as pick up or talk. There is a single "use" verb for objects in the inventory, which varies in effect depending on Richard's location. Occasionally, Richard will have to fight monsters in an arcade sequence with a crossbow.

206819.overview: Tinyus is a faithful Amiga OCS port of the Arcade Gradius/Nemesis videogame It has been created by Fade1/aBYSs who is doing the graphics, Pink/ABYSs who is doing the music and code, Bartman/aBYSs who will be doing the reverse engineering, and all of this requiring an OCS with 512k Chip and 512k Slowmem or better! (Amiga 1200 (barebone) is recommended for fluid 50fps gameplay)

209096.overview:
Aardvarks is a Lemmings clone that also pays tribute to the TV series The Raccoons and Doctor Who. 

As in Lemmings, the goal in each level is to guide a number of small creatures that fall onto the level from a mid-air entrypoint (in this case, a UFO) over to the exit point. To do this you will need to assign some of the creatures skills (exploding, blocking, building, horizontal digging and vertical digging) that allow them to alter the terrain, bypass obstacles and avoid danger. Otherwise, the creatures will walk continuously forward until they either fall off an edge, or hit a wall and start walking back the other way.

209119.overview:
AirTaxi is a Space Taxi variant, first published in Amiga Power magazine's cover disk and later released to public domain. Its basic premise involves running a taxi firm in outer space. There are no drunks or kissing couples to deal with, just 3 classes of passengers, dressed in yellow, red or white. There are a number of bases on each level, and a succession of customers will appear and hail you.

When you land on that base, they tell you where to take them by giving the target base's number. Get there successfully, and they financially reward you - crash, and you'll lose a life and have to pay their relatives off, which can be financially crippling early in the game. Later levels add magnetic fields, hazardous terrain and adjusted gravitational systems. You can have up to five players with a joystick adapter, which is chaotic as collisions cause both players to crash.

209188.overview:
The Amazing Adventures of Harry Haddock is a freeware platformer game for the Amiga. You use the joystick to control a smiling grey cartoon fish wearing red shorts that walks about on its tail fins. The level scrolls left-to-right across terrain such as wooden docks and small boats. There are a various items to collect for point bonuses like gemstones and food items, and enemies to avoid such as flying seagulls and snapping crabs. Some platforms move around, or disappear and reappear. There is also a time limit to complete each level. Curiously, it seems that Harry Haddock can only survive on land, and dies by falling into water.

As its main in-game music, the game features a chiptune rendition of the 1993 Eurodance hit "Saturday Night" by Whigfield.

209191.overview:
Amoeba Invaders is a single player, keyboard or joystick controlled, Space Invaders clone.

Gameplay is pretty much the same as all other games of this type, the player has a cannon which can move left and right. It hides behind four houses that are gradually reduced to rubble before being completely destroyed by a screen full of descending alien ships. Every so-often a mother ship flies across of the screen. During the game an extra base is awarded when the score exceeds 1500 points, but there is only one extra base per game.

One feature this game has which many games do not is that the player can choose map their own keys to the Left/Right/Fire and Pause actions. When a game is over the high score for the gaming session is updated but it is not saved for later and the player is not prompted for their name/initials.

209196.overview:
Angband is a member of the roguelike RPGs.

The goal of the game is to descend in the dungeons and become powerful enough to defeat the evil Morgoth at the bottom of the dungeon.

Angband is an updated version of the game Moria, adding more monsters, character races and classes; deepening the dungeon from 50 levels to 100; and including such new features as monster pits and unique items.

209197.overview:
Anti PC is a relaxing sci-fi game to recover from a bad day. As an Amiga space fighter pilot, the player must shoot at hostile objects of PC origin. 

To eliminate the familiar-looking enemy, designated number of hits is required with a limited number of missiles. The space fighter may be moved left and right side, while the hostile object comes from the top of the screen.

209198.overview:
ArtPazz is a shareware puzzle game where the player has to piece together the tiles an image has been split into. The size and the shape of the tiles can be adjusted, which allows to set the difficulty to anything from to tremendously easy to brain-wracking.

The images that come with the game are famous paintings. Players can also add their own images and tunes to the game.

209231.overview:
A Day at the races is a horse race business sim. 

You can take loans from the bank, buy and sell horses from the stables, train your horses and finally participate in the races where you can bet on yourself when you're confident enough. You'll then see an animation of the horses battling it out. You can also take loans on the bank, but they will require you to pay it back after awhile. Game is over if you run out of money.

209260.overview: Ack-Ack is a WWII shooter where your object is to use your anti-aircraft gun to shoot down all the attacking planes before they manage to drop a bomb on you.

209264.overview:
Act of War is a turn-based, tactical squad combat game that shares a number of similarities with the later X-COM series, but also has similarities to Laser Squad. The game is played over a series of missions and can be played as a co--op with a friend. It also features a level editor. 

The missions are complex and vary a lot. For example in the mission "Escape",  the year is 2165. Three squad members have been found quilty of a number of crimes and sent to a futuristic space prison what they now must escape from. One of them managed to sneak in a plastic explosive. while the other two are stuck in their cells.  So, if the first squad member can break out, obtain a gun, free his comrades, teleport onto a nearby shuttle, kill the crew and destroy the targeting computer with a grenade, they might just have a chance.

209283.overview:
Counting with ADI Junior 6-7 is aimed at second year infants and leads to the Key Stage 1 Standard Assessment Tests (SATs) which are taken by all UK children at the age of 7. This disc takes them into the exciting theme of a fairground. The games they play help them not only with counting and number work, but also assist with pattern matching and spatial skills so necessary to a true understanding of math work. 

The average child would expect to succeed at Level 2 of the SATs. This program reinforces and develops the work begun in Counting with ADI Junior 4-5, but has some more challenging games to cater for the brighter, more advanced child who is expected to succeed at Level 3.

209284.overview: Another conversion of of Will Crowther's and Don Woods' ADVENTURE, the first text adventure game about exploring the Mammoth Cave, a curious microcosm of American history, originally developed on university mainframes.

209285.overview:
Adventure was the very first text adventure. It was started by Will Crowther, who wrote a Fortran simulation of the Bedquilt cave system. Don Woods added magic and puzzles, and in 1977 Adventure was released to the world. 

Presented here is a version very close to the original + five other ports with various levels of modifications and extensions. The game also features a convenient interface and comes with a digital manual, including a walkthrough.

209286.overview:
Another conversion of of Will Crowther's and Don Woods' ADVENTURE, the first text adventure game about exploring the Mammoth Cave, a curious microcosm of American history, originally developed on university mainframes.

This port is faily close to the original. The puzzles, items and places of Woods' original 350-point version are exactly those here.

209296.overview: Air Ace II is a WWI -themed shoot'em up made with SEUCK and love and above average for SEUCK games. With S.E.U.C.K. created a fairly fast, high-class shooting game. For twitchy joystick users to enjoy!

209298.overview:
Based on a C64 game called Super Dogfight, Air Fight is a simple single-screen dogfight shooter for one or two players. 

The game was later updated to 2.0 that included an option to set the control precision, but besides that and an upgraded title screen, there were no other changes.

209299.overview: Air Hockey is, well, an air hockey game where you hit a puck along the table that has a cushion of air on it that makes it slide. If you want to make a rocket shot, trap the puck to the corner and then get out of the way.

209300.overview:
Airmania! is essentially an adventure game. You have ten minutes to catch a flight at the airport. Buy your ticket, check in your baggage, go through passport control, buy as much duty free as possible, and get to the departure gate in time. If you did this in three levels and then phoned the developers, you were apparently eligible for free air trip around the world.

The protagonist is PiMan, a character who originally appeared in the 1982 game Pimania.

209301.overview:
A common criticism of adventure games generally and works of interactive fiction specifically is that they oftentimes suffer from what have been characterized as "read-the-designer's-mind" puzzles -- making necessary apparently arbitrary (and sometimes seemingly absurd) actions that produce unreasonable-to-expect results; the puzzles look kosher in a walkthrough but only make sense to a player after the fact, knowing of their implausible effect. 

Aisle is the inverse: the designer has instead had to read the player's mind, predicting which actions, likely or unlikely, the player is apt to attempt in the somewhat under-stimulating environment (certainly an unusually pedestrian game setting) of the Italian foods section of a supermarket late one Thursday night. Rather than the player wandering the market and interacting with objects contained there in the conventional adventuring fashion, this game permits the player only a single move... that move triggering a memory, hinting at a roiling and turbulent backstory that can only be more fully appreciated by unlocking more recollections. 

Upon completion of the single move, the protagonist leaves the market and the game concludes -- then restarts, giving the player another crack at glimpsing another, parallel facet of the memories the shelves of pasta provoke.

209305.overview: After the great war, all surviving aliens got sent to a prison planet. Now they are trying to escape. You, the valiant hero, has to murder them all. Mow down all running green aliens before they reach the right side of the screen, which presumably leads to a spaceport.

209307.overview: The year is 2067 and our valiant hero is at it again. After a couple of levels, the ground of the planet is littered with bloody, lifeless corpses of aliens hopelessly trying to get to safety as your job is to mass murder them before they reach their goal of freedom and happiness.

209308.overview:
Originally featured on the cover disc of Amiga Format -magazine, when you see a game called "Girl Actions", you wouldn't probably  think "Galaxian clone". That, however, is exactly what this game is. The name is a play on words as it sounds like Galaxians.

Later released by far more sensible name "Alien Fight", your job is to shoot the aliens before they reach the ground.

209349.overview: Space exploration meets Eye of the Beholder in this deep space dungeon-crawler written for the Amiga Format magazine's Blitz Basic 2 -competition.

209351.overview: Alienoid is a breakout clone in a space battle setting. Bounce the ball to take out the blocks and destroy the UFOs.

209353.overview:
All Rounder is a shareware cricket game for the Amiga, it can be played by two people or by one person against the computer.

This game is based on a board and dice game from the seventies which inspired the author to develop first a game for the ZX81 and later games for the VIC 20 and the BBC B.

This game features graphics and 198 players, in it the player plays a full season of 153 games where all seventeen teams play each other. It also has a summary mode of play which enables the player to skip a match and let the game work out a result.

209354.overview: Allrox is a vertical scrolling shoot'em up in a space setting.

209358.overview:
Almagica: Scions Of A Forgotten World is an RTS not unlike Command & Conquer that was never ported to the platform. As Amiga was losing its commercial power, fewer and fewer games were ported to it, so the developers saw a business potential. In the end, the plan didn't work out as the game was never released. What was released however was a functional preview, letting us play this one.

Gameplay follows the principles of the standard RTS formula. You click the mouse on any subject or building and a group of buttons specific to the selection pop ups on the right. From here you can tell workers to move to a certain location, start cutting down trees for lumber (an important commodity), or build buildings (what the lumber is for). Adding the different types of buildings allows you to increase the speed of growth of your population.

The object is to build up your population and army and then wipe out the other tribes.

209369.overview: Alpha Fight is a split-screen horizontal shooter made by a demogroup.

209435.overview: Ambassador is a slot machine simulator that the developer John Ingham (Transvamp) updated for years, sometimes renaming the game in the process while not changing anything fundamental in it.

209452.overview:
In the year 2013, The Amegan system developed a method of training its warriors to protect their star colonies. Over the city of Komar, android-controlled fighters raced to engage and destroy these Amegan warriors. The Amegan method is so successful it commands fear and respect from all throughout the galaxies. The method is codenamed Amega Race.

Amega Race is a remake of an 1981 arcade game, Omega Race. You control a small triangle, i.e. your spaceship. The ship can turn, move forward with thrusters and fire "Droid" ships that attack you. Once the ship is moving, it can only be slowed by turning the nose in the opposite direction and using the thrusters.

There is no end to this game. Rather, it is a game in which you try to get the highest score, or complete the highest number of levels.

209455.overview:
Ami Mind is a take on classic  code-breaking game MasterMind. 

The computer sets the pattern and the player tries to guess the pattern, in both order and color, within ten turns. Each guess is made by placing a row of code pegs on the decoding board. Once placed, the computer provides feedback by placing from zero to four key pegs in the small holes of the row with the guess. A green key peg is placed for each code peg from the guess which is correct in both color and position. A white key peg indicates the existence of a correct color code peg placed in the wrong position.

Released in the following:

[1] Intersoft 1213
[2] Released 1993-03-03 on Amiga Fantastic Software issue 3 March/April.

209456.overview:
Amiga Boulder Dash is, unsurprisingly, a Boulder Dash variant. It features two different versions of the game and a construction kit.

In each level you must collect a certain number of diamonds in order to open a portal to the next stage while avoiding flying enemies and falling boulders.

209457.overview: Amiga Bridge plays, unsurprisingly, the game bridge. It supports a subset of the bidding system and is the first non-commercial bridge program available for the Amiga.

209459.overview:
Chinese Checkers is neither a variation of checkers nor did it originate from China. It was originally created in Germany as "Stern-Halma" and coined as "Chinese Checkers" as part of an US marketing scheme.

The objective is to be first to race all of one's pieces across the hexagram-shaped board into "home"—the corner of the star opposite one's starting corner—using single-step moves or moves that jump over other pieces.

209462.overview: Amiga Columns is a shareware take on the puzzle arcade game Columns. Your mission is to match blocks of the same color in order to remove them. Another Tetris variant that was originally developed for MS-DOS (X-Windows) and converted by the author. It looks very simple at first - but long-lasting fun is guaranteed! Key control via 'j', 'k', 'l' and the space bar.

209464.overview: Amiga Empire is a take on Empire, a multiplayer game up to 100 players that deals with exploration, economics and war. The object of the game is simple - gain control of the entire world by using your armies to crush your opponents. You'll start off with a city, which must then produce armies, that are used to conquer more cities.

209465.overview: Amiga GnuChess is port of Gnu Chess 4.0. You can use mouse to all (valid) moves, edit the board, ask for help and switch players at any time.

209472.overview:
Amiga Lazer Zone is based on Jeff Minter's 1983 shoot'em'up Laser Zone for c64. It has you controlling not one, but two "zone gunners" in a constrained playfield. Controlled with only one joystick, you move one zone gunner on a vertical wall and one at the bottom. 

Wave upon wave of nasties come into the zone and must be shot down before they reach either wall, where they will advance towards the gun, finally destroying it.

209473.overview: This public domain version of the classic board game is German, multiplayer-only and supports six simultaneous players. The graphics are basic as it was written in Amiga Basic, otherwise it has all the features the original game has.

209486.overview: Before Nintendogs there was Amiga Pets, a virtual life simulator running on your workbench. You can talk, feed & play with your pet, give it various toys and objects to play with and even take it to a baseball match. If your pet gets injured, you can call a doctor to help it out.

209490.overview:
Omega is usually considered the first roguelike game with a traditional plot. AmiOmega is Omega's Amiga port; named differently on the platform due to Origin's tank design/programming game "Omega" released the previous year.

In AmiOmega, you play a protagonist that has been transported to another world by the Omega Project. You are trying to become an Adept, a person of immense power who follows the Buddhism-like principles of the Lords of Omega, by undergoing a series of quests.

209492.overview:
Amiga Risk is a computer adaptation of the well known board game. The game is played on a world map where the objective is to take control of all 42 territories. The game is played by three to six generals that can be human or AI controlled. 

There are several different computer generals to choose from, each having their own character and strategy with varying difficulty. The game features hi-def graphics and clean interface.

209495.overview: Amiga Roulette is a German roulette simulator for 1-4 players.

209499.overview: Amigaboy Tetris runs a mockery gameboy emulator (Mintendo's Amiga Boy) and plays Gameboy's Tetris, possibly the most played Tetris conversion in existence as it was included with the Game Boy upon its release in several territories.

209500.overview: A "Concentration" game for the Amiga, where you must locate matching tiles on a grid that can range from 4x4 (easy) to 12x12 (difficult). Up to four players.

209526.overview:
Amiwalé is a wordplay on Awelé, one of the many names of the traditional Ghanaian board game Owale played around Africa and throughout the Caribbean. 

The game has a board and 48 seeds. The objective of the game is to capture more seeds than one's opponent. 

The game features extensive instructions on the rules how to play the game, mutiple difficulty levels and the possibility to make both players be played by the computer.

209561.overview: Amoeba Strip 69 is tic-tac-toe variant where you need to get five in a row to win. Possibly the only adult tic-tac-toe game in the existence, you'll get rewarded with a topless picture after each win.

209563.overview: A-Mopoly is a German Monopoly clone. Buy, trade and develop properties, collect rents and drive your opponents into bankruptcy.

209565.overview: Slot machine for up to four players. One of the features is "Nudge"; when you get those, you can choose to flip one of the wheels to the direction you want for as many times as you have nudges.

209567.overview:
AMOS Cricket is a cricket simulator that features, among other things, various skill levels that are independently adjustable, preset teams and a team editor. As the editor also works mid-game, one of the features is a built-in cheat engine, should you wish to do so. 

The game is played from a top-down perspective and requires both mouse and joystick as the batsman is played with the joystick and the bowler with the mouse.

209568.overview:
Never released separately, this compilation is a strange combination of a bowling simulator and a puzzle game by the same developer.

AMOS Tenpin Bowling is a bowling game for one or two players.

LogiCircuit is a puzzle game where your mission is to connect logic circuit from a to b through a circuit board by using various gates.

209570.overview:
Amy's Fun-2-3 Adventure is, according to the accompanying documentation, a commercial-quality edutainment game teaching math.

There are four games included in this package, all involving Amy, an animated cartoon dog. Three of the four games are math-based, and pretty basic for learning numbers. The fourth game is a music-based game where, using a virtual xylophone, you play classic kid's songs by hitting the correctly numbered keys or by reading the notes.

209571.overview: Am-Tank is an artillery clone for Amiga similar to Scorched Earth. Before a battle, you get to set the mountain height, air resistance and sound effects.  You move your tank and the camera, set the angle and the power of your cannon, and then fire. Whoever gets the first hit wins. The game lacks computer-controlled tanks, so the game is designed for only two players.

209576.overview: Android Arena is an action game where you must move an android around each level shooting any enemies and avoiding any flames that might happen to be bursting from the floor boards.

209580.overview: Animal Land is an edutainment title for small children that helps to learn the living conditions of different animals.

209586.overview: Aniso is a puzzle game, that is simple to understand but hard to master. In it, you have two grids (from 3*3 to 8*8).  One of the grids is filled with numbers while the other one is empty. The idea behind the game is to form an image of the first grid to the second. When you click one of the squares inside the grid, the square and its immediate neighbors will get a "1" in them. The numbers will be incremented by one on each click, with a wraparound after four. Additionally, you can only click a square just once.

209590.overview: Amiga-Win is a slot machine simulator with, instead of fruits, has Amiga-themed pictures on its wheels.

209592.overview:
Annoyotron is a text adventure that proudly announces itself the most annoying game of all time. While I'm sure a few developers would take serious issue with that statement, I don't see them really winning an argument on the subject.

Annoyotron breaks new ground as it is one of a virtual handful of games that do not seek, ultimately, to be entertainment. The effect that most games wish to bring forth from their audience is one of "player fun." It is almost law. A game designed to stimulate its player in a different way is rare, yes -- but still, most of those games attempt to incorporate a good time within their processes.

Annoyotron offers no such escapes, no such virtue. It is fundamentally impossible to have a good time playing Annoyotron. Unless one is somehow able to force another soul into experiencing it with the promise that a hilarious endgame awaits. Even then, a perverse pleasure in wasting another human being's time is really more responsible for the following glee than the Annoyomatic.

Few games have balls brass enough to challenge our perceptions on what computer games can be. Annoyotron chooses a different path, snickering at all other modern entertainment software with a smarmy, crooked grin. Like a prank you are not in on, you will not appreciate this masterpiece until it has made you its dirty diaper. It serves to give us pause and consider the trappings we fall in within this genre and allow us to speak definitively of what software designed to entertain should not be.

209603.overview:
After the first few millenia of happily obliterating each other, the two separate species of ants, the blacks and the reds, were teetering on the brink of extinction. Into this somewhat dodgy situation in popped Joel Battistututu, an ant completely convinced that he was the second incarnation of Christ. 

Joel decided to try his utmost to preserve the remaining ants by genetically manipulating them being completely identical - how could you destroy something that is identical to yourself after all? After some careful thinking, the ants decided to kill each others anyway.

Ant Wars II (or Ant Wars 1.9)  is a hybrid between Artillery games like Scorched Earth and Worms. Your goal is to destroy the opposing ant colony using the weapons available that you can buy from the armory with the money you get from the field or buy winning the rounds.

209604.overview:
Earth was destroyed in a global cataclysm caused by the amoeba which had caused the earth to flip over on its acis and fly towards the sun causing a super-nova. Eddy Littler, a man of immense wealth, managed to escape in his private space ship. Consequently, so did a colony of ants living in Eddy's dreadlocks.

More of a strategy game than its sequel, Ant Wars is a hybrid between Artillery games and Worms.

209610.overview:
Antispyrel is an unreleased platformer that was done all the way up to the final level until the developer Stefan van de Horst  of 1001 Software Developments abandoned the project. While a working version exists, there's no intro available and therefore no context on who you are or why you are there. 

Graphics tell you that you're a scientist inside a factory of some sort and you aim to move on by either jumping and cllimbing or by solving small puzzles.

209624.overview:
You are the antmaster. Your mission is to give doom or deliverance to hundreds of tiny dot-like creatures called The Ants. Direct armies of hundreds of tiny ants with your mouse cursor and guide them in destroying food, obstacles, bigger insects or make them march to their doom. 

Attacking the enemies will reduce your ants fast while eating food will increase their numbers rapidly to the maximum of 100. Leave the ants alone and they'll start wandering around, eventually ending up killing themselves by walking into various deadly traps.You need to balance between each game element to get the insect and move on to the next level.

209625.overview: This is only a slight modification of the game Magic Forest that came free with Amos Professional package as a reference game, together with its source code. The object of the game is to catch the apples before they stop bouncing.

209809.overview:
Orbiting a water planet on the outer edge of Cyo-Federation space, an observation satellite briefly detected a fleet of aliens before its transmission was cut. You are sent to investigate. Upon entering the atmosphere, your ship mysteriously malfunctions.

Aquakon is a first-person shooter created by Lee Bamber that will immerse you in an aquatic world filled with hostile aliens.

209837.overview:
Arcade Darts is for anyone who occasionaly fancies a game of darts but can't find either a dartboard or someone to play with.

The player's hand is controlled with the mouse, although the player only has a certain amount of influence over its movement. The hand will drift around the board and it will take some practice to gain any real measure of control.  This can be compensated by using more or less power and adjusting the release of the dart to cause it to fly to the left or right. 

Different game rules available are extensive and include 301/501, Mickey Mouse/Tactics, Shove Ha'penny, Round the Board, Killer and Shanghai. The games can be played either as a single game, challenge mode against all 16 opponents or in speed mode where you attempt to set a new best time.

209865.overview: Arcadia is a straight-up breakout clone for the Amiga. The game was developed by Ronnie Simpson and released into the public domain in 1990.

210043.overview: Ashido, a word play on Ishido, is a puzzle game in which your goal is to place 62 tiles with 6 different patterns and 6 different colors on a 12x7 playing field in a way that only tiles with the same color or pattern touch. There are six game variants.

210109.overview: Ask Me Another is a picture quiz game for kids in which you get to pick from 20 categories ranging from baby animals to silhouettes, pick your answer from the pre-select list and get a round of applause for a reward.

210110.overview: Assault simulates a merciless shooting range. One of the empty squares will suddenly occupy a target and you have less than a second to get it, otherwise it's game over.

210114.overview:
Not a typo, this is Asteriods 2! What do you get when you combine Asteroids, Sinistar,  Mine Storm, and just about any  decent Asteroids derivative into one game? Why, you get Mike Seifert's Asteriods II, of course.

Take the original game, throw in power-ups, enemy fighters, motherships, and the classic vector graphics of the arcade original,  and you have Asteriods II.

The game can be set for different game speeds and the level of play can be boosted or lowered. Asteriods II also features a two player mode - both players can brave the universe as teammates, or they can fight as bitter opponents while also blasting the invading forces.

210211.overview:
Astrotrek is an arcade game proudly stealing its premise from Star Trek: The Next Generation in which you fly the Enterprise through a meteor storm. 

If you ever wanted to know what Picard sounds like in German, here's your chance as the voice samples are taken from the German dubbed version of the series.

210263.overview: Atari Busters is a multi-genre game ranging from racing to fighting to cave flying.

210271.overview:
Atic Atac for Amiga is a conversion of the 1983 ZX Spectrum game. It mixes arcade gameplay with exploration of a large castle and light puzzle-solving. The player needs to find a way out of the castle he's trapped in. In order to do that, he must find the required keys.

Enemies appear in each room. The player can choose to collide with them, which destroys the enemies but also drains health from the main character. Some enemies cannot be killed by conventional means and must be either avoided or dealt with by using special items.

The player character's life meter gets gradually depleted. Health can be restored by consuming food scattered around the castle, but the countdown cannot be stopped.

210298.overview:
In the beginning of time, Gods arose and created an island in the middle of a great ocean. In the centre of this island they constructed a large black tower from where they could rule. The Gods were fair and ruled the four kingdoms with justice and kindness for until they disappeared.

After five years, the life in Atlantis was a disaster, as the land was rife with plague and disease as well as gangs of robbers plundering everywhere. The kings of the four kingdoms set off to wander the four kingdoms in search of the keys to enter the tower and solve this mystery.

Atlantis is a German tactical RPG in a classic fantasy setting.

210302.overview: After an explosion in your laboratory the atoms of various elements are racing abour inside your nuclear reactory. They are becoming increasingly unstable and must be made safe. This is achieved by manipulating positrons to direct the atoms into the appropriate de-ionising vortexes to make them safe.

210303.overview:
Atomic Bombers is a multiplayer Bomberman variant with a top down view and simplistic controls.Your mission is to kill your enemies without getting blasted yourself.. Each basic bomb explodes into a cross-shaped blast (four directions) which can destroy either enemies or blocks. 

In addition to the classic Bomberman gameplay, this version introduces additional gameplay mechanics, including light management, force options, atomic bombs and various illnesses that include the player gaining invulnerability or turning into a pac-man for a limited time.

The game also comes with a level editor.

210304.overview: Atomic Food Chess is a chess game with fruits and other food items replacing the traditional chess pieces.

210305.overview: Atomic II is a puzzle game. The object is to guide several balls into their colour-coded holes. This is done by manipulating various direction controllers scattered around the levels.

210306.overview:
Atoms: The story of Atoms is a take on an Atari ST multiplayer puzzle game ST-Atoms, itself a version of a 1984 type-in game Critical Mass. 

Your goal is to wipe out all the other players' atoms before they do it to you. Players take turns to place an atom of their colour on the playing grid. When too many atoms get together in a single sqiare it will overload and blow outwards to the surrounding squares, possibly overloading them and continuing the blast.  When the atoms get blasted, they will change their color to that of the current player.

210317.overview:
Atoms is one of the many unofficial remakes of the 1984 type-in game Critical Mass. 

Your goal is to wipe out all the other players' atoms before they do it to you. Players take turns to place an atom of their colour on the playing grid. When too many atoms get together in a single square, it will overload and blow outwards to the surrounding squares, overloading them and continuing the blast.  When the atoms get blasted, they will change their color to that of the current player.

210318.overview:
Atoms!, not to be confused with "Atoms" released the same year and dealing with the same game concept, is one of the many unofficial remakes of the 1984 type-in game Critical Mass.

Players take turns to place an atom of their colour on the playing grid. When four atoms get together in a single square it will overload and blow outwards to the surrounding squares, overloading them and continuing the blast. When the atoms get blasted, they will change their color to that of the current player. Your goal is to wipe out all the other players' atoms before they do it to you.

210320.overview:
Modeled after the arcade game Ataxx, Attacks is a reversi variant where you try to fill a bigger portion of the board than your opponent. You can only move either next to your own piece in which case both the old and the new piece will stay on board or jump over an empty square, in which case the original position will empty itself. All pieces surrounding the one you moved to will change their color to yours. 

The game is concluded when either all the empty squares are filled or only one color is remaining.

210326.overview:
Built around a shoot'em'up engine developed in 1994, A-Type was put together using ripped graphics from the famous R-Type for the 32K game compo at the Mekka/Symposium demo party in 1998. Though the game is superficially similar to R-Type, it features a different level layout (only one level to fit into 32 kilobytes) and different play mechanics.

While there's plenty of weapon upgrades around and your ship comes with a powerful autofire, the enemies can absorb a lot of shots. The game does not end with a boss battle, instead the level shrinks until you crash into a greeting message!

210329.overview:
Paid by the German Ministry of Foreign Affairs, "Auf dem Weg nach Europa" or "On the Way to Europe" is a german-only multi-genre advergame combining quiz and arcade sections aiming to bring "Europe closer together". 

Your mission is to travel across 12 EU countries, collect souvenirs and return to Brussels. You get the souvenirs on each country by getting the right answers on the trivia sections. Traveling between the countries costs money and you only have 600 ECU's (European Currency Unit, later replaced by its far more famous little brother Euro), so you need to earn more to make it. As luck would have it, you can earn more cash by mastering the action sequences.

210331.overview: Automobiles is a top-down racing game up to four players made by Tero Heikkinen of the Finnish demo group Overflow that sometimes created games on top of their base activities.

210333.overview: Avalanche is a fast-paced puzzle game. The objects are dropping on a five different tracks and your goal is to make them match in the area below the tracks. Instead of the blocks themselves, you move a container underneath the tracks that can collect up to five falling pieces.

210334.overview: Avina Blue is a conversion of an Atari ST game published the same year. You guide a space ship at a high speed through narrow passages while shooting the opponents in a mission to destroy the threat to mankind inside Avina Blue, an orbiting software satellite before it can spread a video game so powerful it will turn humans into zombies.

211002.overview:
Amigo the Fox is a full length recreation of Mike Wiering's Mario for DOS, ported as an open-source flagship sample game for the Scorpion Engine.

Minimum 1MB A500. A1200 recommended.

211005.overview: The protagonist, Johny Jones, have been mutated by the curse of Abu Simbel, becoming a strange creature that only conserves his enormous nose of his old appearance. In order to get rid of the curse he is forced to travel to Egypt to the pyramid where is the tomb of Abu Simbel, and where it must arrive after discovered the keys that will lead him to this place. If he obtains it, he will recover his normal appearance. As logical, the pyramid is filled of traps and strange creatures who will suppose a serious obstacle for our pretensions, and the only weapon is our skill to be jump from a side to another one without falling in the claws of our enemies, or the traps that are in all places. He can do long or short jumps, according to the situation in which one is.

211008.overview: Prepare to scream profanity at your keyboard because one of the "most difficult games of Spanish Software History" is yet again getting a conversion to the Amiga thanks to S0Y who has used the Amiga game creation software of Redpill. Abu Simbel Profanation was the third in the Johnny Jones Saga and was released in 1985 for Spectrum, Amstrad CPC and MSX. The game was developed by Victor Ruiz and released by Dinamic Software in Spain (and Gremlin Graphics throughout the rest of Europe).

211009.overview:
The message used our frequency, but it didn't come from any of our commanders. It couldn't be! After verifying its content, there was no room for doubt: a spaceship of our defense forces of the future had problems, but it had problems in our time. How was that possible?

The ship has been infiltrated by foreign forces and was going to crash in the Arctic zone, which was under enemy control. The question arose immediately -- Could they seize our technology of the future...? It can't be allowed!

Our best man must go into the enemy base to reach the rest of the ship and take off. Objective: to obtain our technology of the future. The mission doesn't seem easy. For that reason, it has been entrusted to Derdhal, who had already been victorious in dangerous missions in Army Moves and Navy Moves (with the same gaming style), demonstrating a deep knowledge of all the guerrilla techniques and expertise in handling computer networks.

The U-92 submarine leads you to the enemy base. When you are above the frozen surface of the Arctic, there will be no return. Your first mission will start. Good Luck! You cannot fail.

It's once again back to writing and it's a bit of a special one for this evening, as our good friend DamienD has recently contacted us through the Amiga forums of a new-ish release that has appeared on the Amiga as a port from the Atari ST by meynaf. This is ' Arctic Moves ', the sequel to Dinamic's very addictive yet incredibly difficult action platformer Navy Moves which first appeared in 1989.

211080.overview: Attack of the Petscii Robots is a top-down action/puzzle game. It is inspired by oblique top-down projection games like Ultima, but takes much of the gameplay concepts from first-person shooters. The object is to destroy all the robots. To do this, you have to search objects in the game for weapons and other items to help you along the way. Many scenarios require complex thinking and problem-solving, rather than just action shooting.

211088.overview:
